mapper.select: SELECT execution_id, survey_type, business_type, status, mail_address, file_path, error_message, start_time, end_time FROM directions_execution WHERE execution_id = #{executionId}
SELECT execution_id, survey_type, business_type, status, mail_address, file_path, error_message, start_time, end_time FROM directions_execution WHERE status = 'WAIT' ORDER BY create_date
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM directions_execution WHERE status = #{status}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO directions_execution (execution_id, survey_type, business_type, status, mail_address, file_path, create_user) VALUES (#{executionId}, #{surveyType}, #{businessType}, #{status}, #{mailAddress}, #{filePath}, #{createUser})
mapper.update: UPDATE directions_execution SET status = #{status}, error_message = #{errorMessage}, start_time = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'RUN' AND start_time IS NULL THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE start_time END, end_time = CASE WHEN #{status} IN ('END','ABEND') THEN CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ELSE end_time END, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE execution_id = #{executionId}
UPDATE directions_execution SET file_path = #{filePath}, update_date = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE execution_id = #{executionId}
